name: Birch ply wardrobe, overhead cupboards and desk, Chiswick (standard sizes)
source: Built in Trimble SketchUp through the connector (10 Oct 2026) from the job photos at standard sizes (nothing measured): back wall 2600 wide, ceiling 2500, all in 18 mm birch ply. Tall wardrobe 1000 x 600 x 2100 on the left (two doors with round finger holes; left: top shelf, rail, two shelves low down; right: four shelves over four drawers) with a 400 high top box to the ceiling (one door). Overhead cupboards across the rest of the wall, 350 deep from 1650 to the ceiling, four doors in pairs, a shelf each side. The walls under them lined in birch ply; a 200 deep shelf hung on three black straps; a wall-hung desk 800 x 500, top at 740, with a drawer; a birch ply pegboard on the side wall. Walls are room context (the window, radiator and wall lamp are left out). No dimension lines. Read back face by face; units mm, X along the back wall, Y out from the room, Z up.
